dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the apex to the posterior base, following a smooth spline with deepening curvature toward the lower third.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Broadly rounded morphological point with a large pixel radius; classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual anterior margin contour sloping upward at approximately 30-35 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Broad-based configuration where the maximum horizontal pixel base width exceeds the maximum vertical pixel height by a ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white depigmented patch or scar located just below the apex on the lateral surface; visible notch/indentation on the lower posterior trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense distribution of high-contrast white spherical anomalies (water droplets) covering the dark gray integument across the dorsal and lateral fields.
